description: Load a selection of clients as the call list — the /contacts click-through stack you page through to phone each one. Target with client_ids or the list_clients selection filters (e.g. near_client + radius_miles for 'everyone within 50 miles of this client'). Replaces the current list.

client_ids.description: A list of client ids (from search or list_clients).

county.description: A US county name (use with county_state).

county_state.description: The county's US state as a 2-letter code, e.g. MI.

has_email.description: If true, only include records that have an email on file.

has_phone.description: If true, only include records that have a phone on file.

near_client.description: A client id to search around geographically (use with radius_miles).

near_zip.description: A US ZIP code to search around (use with radius_miles).

q.description: Search text; with multiple words, all must match.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the ZIP or client.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter code, e.g. MI.

tag.description: A tag's grouping_id (from your tags / client selection).

name: make_call_list
title: Make Call List
